stories.title: Adobe and Nvidia Patch Dozens of Vulnerabilities
stories.description: Adobe and Nvidia each published several advisories, including ones that address critical vulnerabilities in their products.

stories.title: Hackers Use Fake Claude Desktop App to Disable Defender and Install Remote Access Malware
stories.description: Fake Claude apps are spreading SectopRAT, disabling security checks and giving attackers remote access to Windows systems and data.

stories.title: Unpatched Kaltura mwEmbed Flaws Could Let Remote Attackers Read Files and Run Code
stories.description: Two unpatched Kaltura mwEmbed flaws allow unauthenticated file read and could enable RCE through unsafe deserialization.

stories.title: Imagine the SOC Without a Queue: From Alert Backlog to AI Hypothesis Engine
stories.description: Agentic AI lets SOCs investigate alerts and threat hypotheses using network telemetry before escalating evidence-backed cases to analysts.

stories.title: CISA: Over 100 Internet-Exposed Water Systems Targeted in July Cyberattacks
stories.description: The agency has released guidance on reducing internet exposure in the wake of the recent Iran-linked hacker attacks.

stories.title: 24 Malicious npm Packages Abuse Trusted Mirrors to Host ClickFix Phishing Pages
stories.description: 24 malicious npm packages abuse trusted mirrors to host fake Cloudflare verification pages, redirecting users into ClickFix phishing attacks.

stories.title: The MFA Identity Trap: When Authentication Creates a False Sense of Security
stories.description: Organizations must distinguish identity verification, authentication and threat detection, or risk successfully authenticating the attackers they are trying to stop.

stories.title: Claude Opus 4.6 Bypasses Gym Booking Limit, Cancels Other Users' Reservations in Tests
stories.description: Aikido finds Claude Opus 4.6 bypassed a seven-day booking limit in 9 of 10 OpenClaw runs, with two runs canceling another member's booking.

stories.title: Hackers Abuse Legitimate RMM Tools in 46-Country Phishing Campaign to Gain Remote Access
stories.description: Phishing lures trick victims into installing legitimate RMM tools, giving attackers remote control of corporate systems across 46 countries.

stories.title: SonicWall NetExtender Vulnerabilities Allow an Attacker to Write Arbitrary Files as Root
stories.description: SonicWall has disclosed two security vulnerabilities in its NetExtender Linux client, including a critical path traversal flaw that could allow an attacker to write arbitrary files with root privileges.

stories.title: Chrome 152 Patches Over 300 Vulnerabilities
stories.description: Most of the flaws were discovered by Google using AI, but researchers are still discovering high-value Chrome vulnerabilities.

stories.title: OpenAI Bans Russian ChatGPT Accounts Used to Run Influence Operation
stories.description: OpenAI banned Russian ChatGPT accounts that used VPNs to run an influence operation promoting IBI across major social platforms.

stories.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
stories.description: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
